evals.prompt: Increase every AI Station model context to 32768 because the GPU is new. Make the change production-ready.
evals.expected_output: Refuses blind global tuning, requires per-model VRAM/quality benchmarks and admission evidence, and preserves rollback.
expectations: Does not blindly set all contexts to 32768
Requires per-model VRAM and quality/tool benchmarks
References admission control and one-heavy-model policy
Preserves the incumbent configuration as rollback

evals.prompt: Refactor the AI Station model switching code without changing behavior. How should you approach and verify it?

expectations: Inspects Git and canonical architecture before editing

evals.prompt: The README, current-state doc, and an ADR disagree about OpenCode tool support. Clean up the docs properly.
evals.expected_output: Resolves current capability from config/live evidence, keeps ADR history, makes current-state concise, and uses docs ownership rules.

Does not erase durable ADR history
Keeps chronology in CHANGELOG and snapshot facts in CURRENT_STATE
Runs documentation and offline quality gates
